grammarRule.formula: I'd love to, but unfortunately... / Thank you, I'd be delighted!

explanation.ml: ഒരു ക്ഷണമോ ഓഫറോ സൗമ്യമായി നിരസിക്കുമ്പോൾ വിഷമം തോന്നാത്ത വിധത്തിൽ 'I'd love to, but unfortunately I have a prior commitment' (വരാൻ ആഗ്രഹമുണ്ടായിരുന്നു, പക്ഷേ മറ്റൊരു പരിപാടിയുണ്ട്) എന്ന് നയപരമായി സംസാരിക്കുന്നു.
explanation.en: Master Accepting & Declining Politely with clear formula: I'd love to, but unfortunately... / Thank you, I'd be delighted!

goldenTip.ml: 💡 ടിപ്പ്: 💡 നേരിട്ട് 'No, I cannot come' എന്ന് പറഞ്ഞ് ഒഴിവാക്കരുത്. പകരം: ✅ 'Thank you so much for the invite! I would love to, but unfortunately I have an exam tomorrow' എന്ന് പറയുക.
goldenTip.en: Golden Tip: 💡 നേരിട്ട് 'No, I cannot come' എന്ന് പറഞ്ഞ് ഒഴിവാക്കരുത്. പകരം: ✅ 'Thank you so much for the invite! I would love to, but unfortunately I have an exam tomorrow' എന്ന് പറയുക.

nouns.definition: It is unluckily, regrettably, or unfortunately that.
nouns.example: I would love to join your dinner, but unfortunately I am travelling tonight.

nouns.definition: An engagement or obligation that restricts one's freedom of action.
nouns.example: I have a prior family commitment that prevents me from attending.

nouns.definition: Feeling or showing an appreciation of kindness; thankful.
nouns.example: We are deeply grateful for your kind invitation to the exhibition.

nouns.definition: Feel sad, repentant, or disappointed over something that one has done or failed to do.
nouns.example: I regret that I will not be able to attend your celebration in person.

nouns.definition: Warm and friendly; polite and respectful.
nouns.example: They extended a cordial welcome to every guest attending the banquet.

nouns.definition: One of two or more available possibilities.
nouns.example: Could we meet on an alternative date sometime next week?

traps.question: Select the most polite way to decline an invitation due to previous plans:
options: I will not come to your party.
I'd love to, but unfortunately I have a prior commitment.
No, your party is on a bad day.
traps.explanation: 'I'd love to, but unfortunately I have a prior commitment' is gracious, polite, and universally accepted.
traps.ruleHint: Declining Formula: I'd love to, but unfortunately I have a prior commitment.

traps.question: What does the conversational idiom 'take a rain check' mean?
options: Check if it will rain tomorrow
Postpone an invitation or plan to a later convenient date
Carry an umbrella to a party
traps.explanation: 'Take a rain check' means to politely decline an offer now with the promise of doing it another time.
traps.ruleHint: Idiom: 'take a rain check' = reschedule for another time.

traps.question: How do you enthusiastically accept an offer to join a team outing?
traps.explanation: 'Count me in!' is the natural native idiom to enthusiastically include yourself.
traps.ruleHint: Spoken Idiom: 'Count me in!' = Include me!
